CustomField.description: Maximum number of tokens a file summary may use. Blank means 80, the default. 0 means no limit. Google Client adds room for the AI's reasoning on top, and a summary is always cut to 255 characters.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Maximum number of tokens a file summary may use. Leave blank for 80, the default, or use 0 for no limit. Summaries are always cut to 255 characters.
CustomField.label: Summary Max Output Tokens
